SELECT 
  --COALESCE(IP.business_date, BM.business_date) AS business_date,
  --COALESCE(IP.hierarchy_node, BM.hierarchy_node) AS hierarchy_node,
  --COALESCE(IP.country_code, BM.country_code) AS country_code,
  COALESCE(IP.LIMIT_NAME, BM.LIMIT_NAME) AS LIMIT_NAME,
  --COALESCE(IP.MEASURE_VALUE_HOLDING, 0) AS MEASURE_VALUE_HOLDING,
  --COALESCE(BM.MEASURE_VALUE_BM, 0) AS MEASURE_VALUE_BM,
    (COALESCE(IP.MEASURE_VALUE_HOLDING, 0) - COALESCE(BM.MEASURE_VALUE_BM, 0)) as MEASURE_VALUE
    
FROM (
    SELECT 
        country.business_date,
        country.hierarchy_node, 
        mapper.country_code, 
        (country.pv / top_level.top_level_pv) * 100 AS MEASURE_VALUE_HOLDING,
        'BCPP_COUNTRY_ISRC_NOT_WEIGHT_' || mapper.country_code || '_GT' AS LIMIT_NAME
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            pos.business_date,
            dn.node_name AS hierarchy_node,
            pos.analytic_value AS pv
        FROM risk_prod.fact_analytic_sd pos
        LEFT JOIN risk_prod.dim_hierarchy_node dn
            ON pos.business_date = dn.business_date 
            AND pos.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dn.dim_hierarchy_node_id
        WHERE pos.business_date = '2025-06-12'
          AND pos.run_id = 'ATP_BCPP_by_Country_source_system_pv'
          AND pos.analytic_type = 'SOURCE_SYSTEM_PV'
          AND dn.node_level = 2
    ) country
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            pos.business_date,
            pos.analytic_value AS top_level_pv
        FROM risk_prod.fact_analytic_sd pos
        LEFT JOIN risk_prod.dim_hierarchy_node dn
            ON pos.business_date = dn.business_date 
            AND pos.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dn.dim_hierarchy_node_id
        WHERE pos.business_date = '2025-06-12'
          AND pos.run_id = 'ATP_BCPP_by_Country_source_system_pv'
          AND pos.analytic_type = 'SOURCE_SYSTEM_PV'
          AND dn.node_level = 1
    ) top_level
        ON top_level.business_date = country.business_date
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            country_code, 
            country_name AS hierarchy_node
        FROM reference.reference_country_codes
        WHERE business_date = DATE '2025-06-12'
    ) mapper
        ON lower(mapper.hierarchy_node) = lower(country.hierarchy_node)
) IP
FULL OUTER JOIN (
    SELECT 
        country.business_date,
        country.hierarchy_node, 
        mapper.country_code, 
        (country.pv / top_level.top_level_pv) * 100 AS MEASURE_VALUE_BM,
        'BCPP_COUNTRY_ISRC_NOT_WEIGHT_' || mapper.country_code || '_GT' AS LIMIT_NAME
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            business_date, 
            hierarchy_node, 
            pv
        FROM risk_prod.benchmark_analytic_pv
        WHERE business_date = '2025-06-12'
          AND benchmark_name = 'ATP BCPP'
          AND node_level = 2
          AND run_id = 'ATP_BCPP_by_Country'
    ) country
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            business_date, 
            pv AS top_level_pv
        FROM risk_prod.benchmark_analytic_pv
        WHERE business_date = '2025-06-12'
          AND benchmark_name = 'ATP BCPP'
          AND node_level = 1
          AND run_id = 'ATP_BCPP_by_Country'
    ) top_level
        ON top_level.business_date = country.business_date
    full outer join (
        SELECT 
            country_code, 
            country_name AS hierarchy_node
        FROM reference.reference_country_codes
        WHERE business_date = DATE '2025-06-12'
    ) mapper
        ON lower(mapper.hierarchy_node) = lower(country.hierarchy_node)
) BM
    ON IP.hierarchy_node = BM.hierarchy_node 
   AND IP.country_code = BM.country_code 
   AND IP.LIMIT_NAME = BM.LIMIT_NAME

SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (
        SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
    ),
	adjusted_date AS (
		SELECT
			query_date,
			CASE
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
				ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
				END AS business_date
		FROM params
	),
     account_mapping_query AS (
         SELECT
             date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
             pam.mx_portfolio_id AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
             pam.bbg_pfolio_id AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
             pam.model_portfolio AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
             pam.sst_account AS SST_ACCOUNT
         FROM reference.model_portfolio_account_mapping pam
                  JOIN adjusted_date ad ON pam.as_of_date = ad.business_date
             )
        SELECT
            COALESCE(BUSINESS_DATE, '') as BUSINESS_DATE,
            COALESCE(TRIM(MUREX_PORTOFOLIO), '') as MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            COALESCE(TRIM(BBG_ACCOUNT), '') as BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SCD_ACCOUNT), '') as SCD_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SST_ACCOUNT), '') as SST_ACCOUNT

        SELECT

           ) AS rn
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    WHERE accounting_framework_id = 'PCLFWKMAIN'
),
JoinedData AS (
    SELECT st.*
    FROM RankedTransactions st
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM asset.enterprise_security
    ) es ON st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id AND es.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
        ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)
        AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd_party_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM party.enterprise_party
    ) ep ON st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id AND ep.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities ss 
        ON st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
        AND ss.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_exchange_codes rec 
        ON es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
        and es.mic = rec.mic
		and es.esm_exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
        AND rec.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country 
        ON es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country 
        ON es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
        AND rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS latest
        FROM reference.scd_portfolio
    ) sp ON sp.latest = 1 AND sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country 
        ON rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
        AND rcc_trade_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (

            abor_transaction_number,
            business_date,
            transaction_cancellation_flag,
            trade_date,
            abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
            amount_quotation_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,

                ORDER BY business_date DESC

        FROM trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
        WHERE transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'

    ON stc.latest = 1
       AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
       AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
       AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc 
        ON st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
        AND rcc.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_currency_codes)

        SELECT *,

        WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    ) spif

        AND spif.rn = 1
)

	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-13 16:06:25'

	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

WITH date_params AS (
SELECT DATE '2024-04-01' AS start_date, DATE '2024-03-31' AS end_date
)
SELECT DLY.adjusted_fx_currency,
EXP(SUM(LN(1 + TWR_CAD))) - 1 AS TWR_CAD,
EXP(SUM(LN(1 + TWR_Local_Exposure_FX))) - 1 TWR_Local_Exposure_FX,
EXP(SUM(LN(1 + TWR_Currency_Adjusted_FX))) - 1 TWR_Currency_Adjusted_FX,
sum(pnl_cad) pnl_cad,
sum(pnl_local_exposure_fx) pnl_local_exposure_fx,
sum(pnl_currency_exposure_fx) pnl_currency_exposure_fx
from
(select business_date,
CASE 
WHEN adjusted_fx_currency IN ('USD','JPY','EUR','CNY','INR') THEN adjusted_fx_currency
ELSE 'Other'
END AS adjusted_fx_currency,
sum(market_value_cad) market_value_cad,
sum(market_value_cad_t_1) market_value_cad_t_1,
sum(cash_flow_cad) cash_flow_cad,
round(sum(round(pnl_cad,2)),2) pnl_cad,
sum(round(pnl_currency_exposure_fx,2)) pnl_currency_exposure_fx,
sum(round(pnl_local_exposure_fx,2)) pnl_local_exposure_fx,
case when coalesce(round(sum(round(pnl_cad,2)),2)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0)=-1 then 0 else coalesce(round(sum(round(pnl_cad,2)),2)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0) end TWR_CAD,
case when coalesce(round(sum(round(pnl_local_exposure_fx,2)),2)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0)= -1 then 0 else coalesce(round(sum(round(pnl_local_exposure_fx,2)),2)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0) end TWR_Local_Exposure_FX,

from performance.pace_holding_pnl
cross join date_params
where performance_configuration_id in ('PC-POOLS')
and model_portfolio_code is not null
and component_type not in (

'Spot',
'Constituent from original',
'Constituent from spot',

'Residual from generic decomposition'
)
and cash_state not in ('Settled cash', 'Unsettled cash')

CASE

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-07')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-07')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328','MPR1000200','MPAR100041')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",

/* QuickSight e7c6aca0-d3f0-46b2-a75f-20d1f3bc9ce7 */
SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, node_name as pbor_node_name
			, "level" as split_level
			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_lc as time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'
			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '5. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '6. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		cmb
	where
		value is not null
		and business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		and not ( pbor_node_name in ( 'Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' ) and metric_type = 'Return' )
)
select * from cmb_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"
WHERE "business_date" > from_unixtime(cast(substr(cast(1749249935810 as varchar), 1, 10) AS bigint))

/* cppi::249c3c7496b1d3ac4448e545e32037aef3899266fe6e0482722ac417b069fadd */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 13
		AND hour between 08 and 09
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-13 08:01:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::1af9b728245a8b8168899b95591b9912863ee6b2fa2cdacb10275da5ab379b30 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 13
		AND hour between 08 and 09
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-13 08:06:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode

					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag

/* cppi::fe817aaff42df49b107f5b534f27f3aac6a475ad5251000e23f991583d0e15cb */
/* QuickSight 7354c590-ab6e-4404-a916-f25f37e8964e */
SELECT "business_date", "pool_name", "account_name", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "external_reporting_dm_em", "external_reporting_region", "external_reporting_country", "external_reporting_assetmix", "business_date_string", "year_month", "is_month_end", "is_fiscalyear_end", "external_reporting_dm_em_region", "external_reporting_currency", "total_market_value_pc"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)
select * from lt_final_agg) AS "finsights_holdings_lookthrough"

SELECT "party_name", "cppib_party_id", "cppib_party_id_str", "parent_cppib_party_id", "ultimate_parent_cppib_party_id", "bloomberg_company_id", "incorp_country_code", "legal_entity_name", "cppib_country_of_exposure_code", "cppib_sector_classification_name_1", "cppib_sector_classification_name_2", "cppib_sector_classification_name_3", "cppib_sector_classification_name_4", "has_securities_flag", "has_children", "has_parent", "party_name_word1", "party_name_word2", "party_name_word3", "party_name_word4", "party_name_word5", "party_name_word6", "party_name_word7", "party_name_word8", "party_name_word9", "party_name_word10", "party_name_word11", "party_name_word12", "party_name_word13", "party_name_word14", "party_name_word15"
FROM (SELECT
    COALESCE(eu."party_name", '') AS "party_name",
    eu."cppib_party_id" AS "cppib_party_id",
    COALESCE(CAST(eu."cppib_party_id" AS VARCHAR), '') AS "cppib_party_id_str",
    COALESCE(CAST(eu."parent_cppib_party_id" AS VARCHAR), '') AS "parent_cppib_party_id",
    COALESCE(CAST(eu."ultimate_parent_cppib_party_id" AS VARCHAR), '') AS "ultimate_parent_cppib_party_id",
    COALESCE(eu."bloomberg_company_id", '') AS "bloomberg_company_id",
    COALESCE(eu."incorp_country_code", '') AS "incorp_country_code",
    COALESCE(eu."legal_entity_name", '') AS "legal_entity_name",
    COALESCE(eu."cppib_country_of_exposure_code", '') AS "cppib_country_of_exposure_code",
    COALESCE(eu."cppib_sector_classification_name_1", '') AS "cppib_sector_classification_name_1",
    COALESCE(eu."cppib_sector_classification_name_2", '') AS "cppib_sector_classification_name_2",
    COALESCE(eu."cppib_sector_classification_name_3", '') AS "cppib_sector_classification_name_3",
    COALESCE(eu."cppib_sector_classification_name_4", '') AS "cppib_sector_classification_name_4",
    CASE
        WHEN eu."has_securities" = 1 THEN 'YES'
        ELSE 'NO'
    END AS "has_securities_flag",
    COALESCE(child_flags.has_children, 'NO') AS has_children,
    CASE
        WHEN eu."parent_cppib_party_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES'
        ELSE 'NO'
    END AS has_parent,

    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 1))  AS party_name_word1,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 2))  AS party_name_word2,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 3))  AS party_name_word3,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 4))  AS party_name_word4,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 5))  AS party_name_word5,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 6))  AS party_name_word6,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 7))  AS party_name_word7,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 8))  AS party_name_word8,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 9))  AS party_name_word9,

            WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'YES'
            ELSE 'NO'
        END AS has_children
    FROM legal_dc_prod.entities_universe

) AS child_flags

	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

SELECT ctev.companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
            country, countrycode, city, region,
            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency,
            cf.period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency,
            investor_id, investor_name, ci.period_end_date as investment_period_end_date,
            percent_of_shares_outstanding as investor_percent_of_shares,
            rank_of_shares_held as investor_rank_of_shares_held
            FROM
            (-- Get company data +TEV
            SELECT companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
                            country, countrycode, city, region,
                            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
                            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT c.companyid, c.companyname, bd.business_description,
                                c.yearfounded, c.webpage,
                                ti.tickersymbol||':'||e.exchange_symbol AS ticker,
                                g.country, g.iso_country_2 AS countrycode, c.city, g.region,
                                c.simpleindustryid,
                                si.simple_industry_description AS simpleindustry,
                                mc.pricingdate,
                                max(pricingdate) over (PARTITION BY c.companyid) AS maxpricingdate,
                                mc.TEV, cur.isocode AS tev_currency
                            FROM capiq_company c
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_business_description bd ON
                                c.companyid = bd.company_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON
                                c.simpleindustryid = si.simple_industry_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqcountrygeo g ON c.countryid = g.country_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqMarketCap mc ON c.companyid = mc.companyid
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON mc.companyId=s.companyId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_exchange e ON e.exchange_id = ti.exchangeId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                            WHERE s.primaryFlag=1
                                AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                                AND simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                                AND companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating
                                                                -- 2=Operating Subsidiary
                                AND companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                                AND ((mc.TEV > 0 and cur.isocode is not null) OR mc.TEV IS NULL)
                                AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%9'
                )
            WHERE pricingdate=maxpricingdate
            ) AS ctev
            LEFT JOIN
            (-- Get LTM fundamentals for Public operating companies
            SELECT DISTINCT company_id,
                period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency

            percent_of_shares_outstanding as investor_percent_of_shares,

            (-- Get company data +TEV
            SELECT companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
                            country, countrycode, city, region,

                                g.country, g.iso_country_2 AS countrycode, c.city, g.region,
                                c.simpleindustryid,
                                si.simple_industry_description AS simpleindustry,
                                mc.pricingdate,

                                mc.TEV, cur.isocode AS tev_currency
                            FROM capiq_company c
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_business_description bd ON
                                c.companyid = bd.company_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON

        ),
             adjusted_date AS (
                 SELECT
                     query_date,
                     CASE

                         WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
                         ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
                         END AS business_date
                 FROM params
             ),
             account_mapping_query AS (
                 SELECT
                     date_format(pam.as_of_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
                     pam.mx_portfolio_id AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
                     pam.bbg_pfolio_id AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
                     pam.model_portfolio AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
                     pam.sst_account AS SST_ACCOUNT
                 FROM reference.model_portfolio_account_mapping pam
                 WHERE pam.as_of_date BETWEEN (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '7' day
                           AND (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '1' day
             ),
             unioned_data AS (
                 select COALESCE(BUSINESS_DATE, '') as BUSINESS_DATE,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(MUREX_PORTOFOLIO), '') as MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,

/* cppi::93587662ae72cf3f00ef2f7bd815835d457ace41623556444aff0fd2463869a8 */
SELECT *
        FROM (
		    SELECT
		        currencyCode,
			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_usd,
					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag
						FROM cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad erc
								LEFT JOIN cppib_market_exchange_rate erd
								ON erc.data_date = erd.data_date
								AND erc.vendor = erd.vendor
								AND erc.currency = erd.currency
							WHERE ((erc.vendor = 'wm' AND erc.currency != 'CLF')
							        OR (erc.vendor = 'tokyo' AND erc.currency = 'CLF'))
								AND erc.currency IN ('USD','EUR','JPY','CHF','AUD','CNY','HKD','NZD','SEK','KRW','SGD','NOK','MXN','INR','DKK','CLF','IDR','CLP','BRL','CAD','MYR','COP','GBP','ARS','RON','RUB','PHP','ILS','PLN','PEN','LTL','LVL','SIT','SAR','ZAR','QAR','CZK','TWD','THB','PKR','TRY','ISK','KWD','AED','JOD','NGN','EGP','HUF','MAD','PGK','MOP','VES','VEF','LKR','BGN','VND','BMD','XOF','BDT','ZMW','KES','HRK','MWK','GHS','MUR','JMD','RSD','TND','KZT','UAH','TTD','OMR','TZS','BWP','UGX','BHD','ZWL','IRR','AZN','BYN','ZWG')

        OR currencyToCadRate is not Null

SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (
        SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
    ),
	adjusted_date AS (
		SELECT
			query_date,
			CASE
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
				ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
				END AS business_date
		FROM params
	),
     account_mapping_query AS (
         SELECT
             date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
             pam.mx_portfolio_id AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
             pam.bbg_pfolio_id AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
             pam.model_portfolio AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
             pam.sst_account AS SST_ACCOUNT
         FROM reference.model_portfolio_account_mapping pam
                  JOIN adjusted_date ad ON pam.as_of_date = ad.business_date
             )
        SELECT
            COALESCE(BUSINESS_DATE, '') as BUSINESS_DATE,
            COALESCE(TRIM(MUREX_PORTOFOLIO), '') as MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            COALESCE(TRIM(BBG_ACCOUNT), '') as BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SCD_ACCOUNT), '') as SCD_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SST_ACCOUNT), '') as SST_ACCOUNT
        FROM account_mapping_query
        UNION
        SELECT
            date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
            '' AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            '' AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '') AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '') AS SST_ACCOUNT
        FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio scd
                 JOIN adjusted_date ad ON CAST(scd.business_date AS DATE) = ad.business_date
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM account_mapping_query fq
            WHERE COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SCD_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '')
              AND COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SST_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '')
        )) T LIMIT 0

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- This query retrieves holdings data and joins it with coupon and security-level
-- metadata. It filters the results based on selected asset types and seniorities,
-- and enriches each record with maturity dates and expected exit information.
-- The data is sourced as-of the latest available business date for accurate and
-- timely reporting.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Acronyms:
-- - ABS   : Asset-Backed Security
-- - CLO   : Collateralized Loan Obligation
-- - CMBS  : Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities
-- - NPL   : Non-Performing Loan
-- - HRR   : High-Risk Rated
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Data Lineage Summary:
-- - Holdings Source:       holdings_uat.ci_sentry_holdings
--                          (CI Sentry - current holdings data)
-- - Security Metadata:     reference.ci_sentry_security
--                          (Reference - asset type, seniority, etc.)
-- - Coupon Metadata:       reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon
--                          (Reference - maturity dates and coupon terms)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Parameters:
-- - business_date     : Latest business date available in ci_sentry_holdings.
-- - asset_type filter : Hardcoded list of included asset types.
-- - seniority filter  : Hardcoded list of included seniorities.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.0.0 | 2025-04-09 | kbaxter@cppib.com
-- - Initial creation: joins holdings with security and coupon metadata, includes
--   filters for asset type and seniority, and applies latest business date.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.1.0 | 2025-04-28 | kbaxter@cppib.com
-- - Corrected filtering - moved the schedules to a CTE. The join and where conditions
--   were causing incorrect result set.
-- - Added the injections for the full table names to allow different environments
-- - Removed reference to ci_sentry_commtiments - funded_amount will come from ci_sentry_holdings.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.2.0 | 2025-05-21 | gstoffer@cppig.com
-- - Updated query to align with new holdings_staging schema
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

WITH

max_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(business_date) AS max_business_date
    FROM holdings_uat.ci_sentry_holdings
),

included_asset_types AS (
    SELECT 'Auto ABS'           AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Bond'               AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'CMBS'               AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'CLO Debt'           AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Construction Loan'  AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Convertible Bond'   AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Delayed Draw'       AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'External Debt'      AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'HRR Bond'           AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Loan'               AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'NPL'                AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Other ABS'          AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Revolver'           AS asset_type
),

included_seniority AS (
    SELECT '1st Lien'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT '2nd Lien'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'ABS Debt'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'B-Note'             AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'CLO Debt'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'First Mortgage'     AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Hold Co/Pref'       AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Jr Sub'             AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Junior Mezzanine'   AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Mezzanine'          AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'RE Mezz'            AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Sr Secured'         AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Sr Subordinated'    AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Sr Unsecured'       AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Unitranche'         AS seniority
),

included_security_type AS (
    SELECT 'convertible'             AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'debt'                    AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'delayedDrawLoanFacility' AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'revolvingCreditFacility' AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'termLoanFacility'        AS sentry_security_type
),

coupon_list AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT  -- Removes multiple loan contract records
        coupon.business_date,
        coupon.security_identifier,
        coupon.sentry_security_type,
        CASE
            WHEN coupon.sentry_security_type IN (
                'delayedDrawFacility',
                'revolvingCreditFacility',
                'termLoanFacility'
            ) THEN coupon.facility_maturity_date
            ELSE coupon.colc_maturity_date
        END AS maturity_date
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_coupon AS coupon
    WHERE CAST(coupon.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-12' AS DATE)
),

schedule_list AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_schedules
    WHERE schedule_name = 'Debt_Factor'
      AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-12' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-12' AS DATE)
          BETWEEN CAST(start_date AS DATE) AND CAST(end_date AS DATE)
)

SELECT
    'Sentry Holdings'                                    AS source,
    HOLD.business_date                                   AS business_date,
    '5fa1e2d3-753f-4ff9-9fe6-09aa13802bc8'                                           AS run_id,
    '2025-06-13 15:14:16'                                AS extract_timestamp,
    '2025-06-13T15:14:16.779385-04:00'                       AS extract_timestamp_iso_8601,
    'America/Toronto'                      AS extract_timestamp_time_zone,
    HOLD.account_id                                      AS account_id,
    SEC.scd_id                                           AS scd_id,
    HOLD.security_identifier                             AS security_identifier,
    SEC.issuer_identifier                                AS issuer_identifier,
    SEC.cppib_security_id                                AS cppib_security_id,
    NULL                                                 AS cppib_entity_id,
    NULL                                                  AS source_data_id,
    SEC.security_identifier                              AS sentry_security_id,
    SEC.issuer_identifier                                AS sentry_issuer_id,
    HOLD.model_portfolio_id                              AS model_portfolio_code,
    NULL                                                  AS deal_id,
    NULL                                                  AS upstream_pipeline_number,
    SEC.security_name                                    AS security_name,
    NULL                                                  AS strategy,
    NULL                                                  AS sub_strategy,
    NULL                                                  AS project_name,
    NULL                                                  AS investment_name,
    NULL                                                  AS country_of_exposure,
    HOLD.native_currency_code                            AS funding_currency,
    NULL                                                  AS deal_currency,
    NULL                                                  AS private_vs_public,
    NULL                                                  AS asset_category,
    NULL                                                  AS seniority,
    NULL                                                  AS risk_rating,
    NULL                                                  AS investment_department_id,
    NULL                                                  AS investment_status,
    NULL                                                  AS investment_lifecycle,
    NULL                                                  AS deployment_disposition,
    NULL                                                  AS sector,
    NULL                                                  AS probability_weighted_investment_amount_local,
    CAST(75123.45 AS DECIMAL(19,6))                      AS funded_amount,  -- TODO: replace with actual field
    CAST(HOLD.qty_net AS DECIMAL(19,6))                  AS quantity_net,
    COUP.maturity_date                                   AS maturity_date,
    CAST(HOLD.total_market_value_local AS DECIMAL(19,6)) AS market_value,
    ACCT.account_number                                  AS portfolio_name,
    SEC.sentry_security_type                             AS sentry_security_type,
    SEC.price_multiplier                                 AS price_multiplier,
    SEC.quantity_multiplier                              AS quantity_multiplier,
    NULL                                                  AS debt_factor,
    HOLD.model_portfolio_id                              AS model_portfolio_id,
    NULL                                                  AS ticket_number,
    NULL                                                  AS probability_of_close,
    NULL                                                  AS binding,
    NULL                                                  AS capital_usage_component,
    'Capital Call/Distribution'                          AS transaction_cash_flow_type,
    NULL                                                  AS send_to_treasury_y_n,
    NULL                                                  AS expected_funding_date,
    NULL                                                  AS expected_trade_date,
    SEC.expected_exit_price                              AS expected_exit_price,
    SEC.expected_exit_probability                        AS expected_exit_probability,
    SEC.expected_exit_date                               AS expected_exit_date,
    NULL                                                  AS expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm,
    NULL                                                 AS unadjusted_exit_projection,
    NULL                                                  AS last_updated_by,
    NULL                                                  AS last_updated_date,
    NULL                                                  AS created_by_user_group,
    NULL                                                  AS created_by,
    NULL                                                  AS date_updated,
    HOLD.business_date                                   AS sentry_holdings_src_business_date,
    SEC.business_date                                    AS sentry_security_src_business_date,
    ACCT.business_date                                   AS sentry_account_src_business_date,
    SCHED.business_date                                  AS sentry_schedule_src_business_date,
    COUP.business_date                                   AS sentry_coupon_src_business_date,
    NULL                                                 AS comment,
    NULL                                                 AS error,
    NULL                                                 AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required,
    NULL                                                 AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date,
    NULL                                                 AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount,
    NULL                                                 AS fo_comments,
    NULL                                                 AS pec_recusals,
    NULL                                                 AS pec_pipeline_y_n,
    NULL                                                 AS fx_spot,
    NULL                                                 AS full_amt_cad_mm,
    NULL                                                 AS rejected_deals_reason,
    NULL                                                 AS investment_program,
    NULL                                                 AS investment_strategy,
    NULL                                                 AS investment_group,
    NULL                                                 AS tfm_inv_sub_strategy,
    'holdings_uat.ci_sentry_holdings, reference_dev.ci_sentry_security, reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_coupon, reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_schedules, reference_dev.ci_sentry_account'
                                                         AS data_sources_list

FROM holdings_uat.ci_sentry_holdings AS HOLD

LEFT JOIN reference_dev.ci_sentry_security AS SEC
  ON HOLD.security_identifier = SEC.security_identifier

INNER JOIN included_asset_types AS ASS_TYPE
  ON SEC.asset_type = ASS_TYPE.asset_type

INNER JOIN included_seniority AS SEN_TYPE
  ON SEC.seniority = SEN_TYPE.seniority

INNER JOIN included_security_type AS SENTRY_TYPE
  ON HOLD.sentry_security_type = SENTRY_TYPE.sentry_security_type

LEFT JOIN coupon_list AS COUP
  ON SEC.security_identifier = COUP.security_identifier

LEFT JOIN reference_dev.ci_sentry_account AS ACCT
  ON HOLD.account_id = ACCT.account_id

LEFT JOIN schedule_list AS SCHED
  ON HOLD.security_identifier = SCHED.security_identifier

WHERE CAST(HOLD.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-12' AS DATE)
  AND CAST('2025-06-12' AS DATE)
      BETWEEN CAST(SEC.start_date  AS DATE) AND CAST(SEC.end_date   AS DATE)
  AND CAST('2025-06-12' AS DATE)
      BETWEEN CAST(ACCT.start_date AS DATE) AND CAST(ACCT.end_date  AS DATE)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- This query retrieves holdings data and joins it with coupon and security-level
-- metadata. It filters the results based on selected asset types and seniorities,
-- and enriches each record with maturity dates and expected exit information.
-- The data is sourced as-of the latest available business date for accurate and
-- timely reporting.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Acronyms:
-- - ABS   : Asset-Backed Security
-- - CLO   : Collateralized Loan Obligation
-- - CMBS  : Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities
-- - NPL   : Non-Performing Loan
-- - HRR   : High-Risk Rated
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Data Lineage Summary:
-- - Holdings Source:       holdings_uat.ci_sentry_holdings
--                          (CI Sentry - current holdings data)
-- - Security Metadata:     reference.ci_sentry_security
--                          (Reference - asset type, seniority, etc.)
-- - Coupon Metadata:       reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon
--                          (Reference - maturity dates and coupon terms)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Parameters:
-- - business_date     : Latest business date available in ci_sentry_holdings.
-- - asset_type filter : Hardcoded list of included asset types.
-- - seniority filter  : Hardcoded list of included seniorities.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.0.0 | 2025-04-09 | kbaxter@cppib.com
-- - Initial creation: joins holdings with security and coupon metadata, includes
--   filters for asset type and seniority, and applies latest business date.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.1.0 | 2025-04-28 | kbaxter@cppib.com
-- - Corrected filtering - moved the schedules to a CTE. The join and where conditions
--   were causing incorrect result set.
-- - Added the injections for the full table names to allow different environments
-- - Removed reference to ci_sentry_commtiments - funded_amount will come from ci_sentry_holdings.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.2.0 | 2025-05-21 | gstoffer@cppig.com
-- - Updated query to align with new holdings_staging schema
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

WITH

max_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(business_date) AS max_business_date
    FROM holdings_uat.ci_sentry_holdings
),

included_asset_types AS (
    SELECT 'Auto ABS'           AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Bond'               AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'CMBS'               AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'CLO Debt'           AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Construction Loan'  AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Convertible Bond'   AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Delayed Draw'       AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'External Debt'      AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'HRR Bond'           AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Loan'               AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'NPL'                AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Other ABS'          AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Revolver'           AS asset_type
),

included_seniority AS (
    SELECT '1st Lien'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT '2nd Lien'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'ABS Debt'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'B-Note'             AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'CLO Debt'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'First Mortgage'     AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Hold Co/Pref'       AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Jr Sub'             AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Junior Mezzanine'   AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Mezzanine'          AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'RE Mezz'            AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Sr Secured'         AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Sr Subordinated'    AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Sr Unsecured'       AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Unitranche'         AS seniority
),

included_security_type AS (
    SELECT 'convertible'             AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'debt'                    AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'delayedDrawLoanFacility' AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'revolvingCreditFacility' AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'termLoanFacility'        AS sentry_security_type
),

coupon_list AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT  -- Removes multiple loan contract records
        coupon.business_date,
        coupon.security_identifier,
        coupon.sentry_security_type,
        CASE
            WHEN coupon.sentry_security_type IN (
                'delayedDrawFacility',
                'revolvingCreditFacility',
                'termLoanFacility'
            ) THEN coupon.facility_maturity_date
            ELSE coupon.colc_maturity_date
        END AS maturity_date
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_coupon AS coupon
    WHERE CAST(coupon.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-12' AS DATE)
),

schedule_list AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_schedules
    WHERE schedule_name = 'Debt_Factor'
      AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-12' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-12' AS DATE)
          BETWEEN CAST(start_date AS DATE) AND CAST(end_date AS DATE)
)

    'Sentry Holdings'                                    AS source,
    HOLD.business_date                                   AS business_date,
    '5fa1e2d3-753f-4ff9-9fe6-09aa13802bc8'                                           AS run_id,
    '2025-06-13 15:14:16'                                AS extract_timestamp,
    '2025-06-13T15:14:16.779385-04:00'                       AS extract_timestamp_iso_8601,
    'America/Toronto'                      AS extract_timestamp_time_zone,
    HOLD.account_id                                      AS account_id,
    SEC.scd_id                                           AS scd_id,

    SEC.cppib_security_id                                AS cppib_security_id,

    SEC.security_identifier                              AS sentry_security_id,
    SEC.issuer_identifier                                AS sentry_issuer_id,
    HOLD.model_portfolio_id                              AS model_portfolio_code,
    NULL                                                  AS deal_id,
    NULL                                                  AS upstream_pipeline_number,
    SEC.security_name                                    AS security_name,
    NULL                                                  AS strategy,
    NULL                                                  AS sub_strategy,
    NULL                                                  AS project_name,
    NULL                                                  AS investment_name,
    NULL                                                  AS country_of_exposure,
    HOLD.native_currency_code                            AS funding_currency,
